run_mlm_training: run masked language modeling fine-tuning on a text dataset without using the HuggingFace Trainer
create_dataset_loader: create a dataset loader that loads text data from CSV, JSON, or txt files for MLM training
build_mlm_data_pipeline: build a data preprocessing pipeline that tokenizes and groups text into chunks of max sequence length
configure_mlm_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay exclusion for layer norm and bias parameters
test_model_perplexity: test the fine-tuned MLM model and compute evaluation perplexity on a validation set
